meta.name: job-changes
meta.description: Job change signal tracking for B2B outbound. Use when the user asks about job change signals, champion tracking, new role outreach, vendor amnesty period, Clay job change monitoring, or days 14-45 engagement window. Do NOT use for general hiring signals (use hiring skill) or company-level events (use company-events skill).

copy.tagline: 追踪B2B客户工作变动信号，把握最佳触达时机
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要监控B2B目标客户的职业变动来优化外呼时机
copy.tagline_en: Track B2B job changes for timely outreach
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor prospect job changes to optimize B2B outreach timing

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 遇职位变动请求会优先用 ColdIQ 检测并标记特免期；若 ColdIQ 未连接，引导配置后回退到 Clay 手动设置。另提供跟踪表配置、时间窗口建议和祝贺消息。
howto.when: 当用户提到职位变动信号、关键人追踪、新岗位外联等关键词时触发；不用于一般招聘信号或公司级事件。

howto.what_en: Claude first tries ColdIQ for job-change tracking, marking the amnesty window. Without ColdIQ, it instructs the user to set it up, then falls back to manual Clay. It also helps with Clay table setup, timing guidelines, and outreach messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions job-change signals, champion tracking, new-role outreach, etc.; not for general hiring or company-level events.
